title: Drop-seq
scope: Macosko 2015 Drop-seq implementation; one schematic workflow repeated in the standalone image and two poster Drop-Seq rows. The target is polyadenylated cellular mRNA represented by barcoded 3′-end cDNA sequence tags. Neighboring poster rows and catalogue similar-method lists do not expand the assigned target.

method_scopes.rationale: The assigned title and both labeled poster rows identify Drop-Seq. The standalone row contains the same unbranched sequence of loading, lysis/capture, pooling, cDNA synthesis/amplification and sequencing; every local operation here applies to the Macosko 2015 implementation verified in the primary paper. The single-cell/poly(A) inset describes the biological target, and the oligo drawing describes bead primer architecture; neither is a separate extraction or bead-synthesis action block. Yellow highlighting marks the RNA protocol target, not an added reagent. The shared constant sequence, bead-specific cell barcode, primer-specific UMI and oligo(dT) explain what the colored legend conveys. CytoSeq, CLaP and Hi-SCL occupy separate poster rows and are outside this extraction. Recovery includes droplet disruption as established by primary text. The broad cDNA block includes the supported interface to a sequenceable library without splitting unshown routine preparation steps.
